desc:
🎤✨ START YOUR K-POP IDOL CAREER! ✨🎤

👍 LIKE the game and ⭐ FAVORITE it so you never miss an update!

It's audition season in Seoul, and every agency in the city has its doors open. Can you go from nervous trainee to K-pop legend?

🎙️ Audition for the Big 4, a mid-size agency, or a small label that really gets you
💃 Train your Vocal, Dance and Charm, and keep your Stress in check
🎶 Debut, drop comebacks, and chase an ALL-KILL on every chart
📸 Survive scandals, rivals and tough choices, all decided in real time
🏆 Win Best New Artist, Bonsang... or the biggest prize in K-pop, the DAESANG
📄 Negotiate your contracts, switch agencies, or go solo
👗 Style your idol and climb the leaderboard

🔁 Every choice changes your story. Will you become a Daesang Legend, a Silver Screen Star, an Idol Mogul... or get CANCELLED? Restart and try for every ending!

This is a K-pop-inspired story game. All agencies, groups and characters are fictional.
